props.markdown:
Behind the dial, the minute shaft carries a small gear. Its teeth fit between the teeth of a larger gear, so where the two meet, their rims travel together, tooth by tooth.

The large gear turns the other way.

props.title: Two gears in mesh, which you can turn
props.textAlternative: **Text version.** The dial is lifted away. Behind it, a small coral gear on the minute shaft meshes with a large yellow gear. When the small gear turns clockwise, the large one turns counterclockwise, more slowly; at the point where they meet, their teeth move together.
